g.text: GDP per capita is a country's gross domestic product divided by its population. This data is adjusted for inflation
and differences in living costs between countries.
Data source: Eurostat, OECD, IMF, and World Bank (2026)
Note: This data is expressed in international-$ at 2021 prices.
